user.title: Host Vitals
user.description: Choose what to watch. Home Assistant's data looks like it is on **{data_disk}**. On a Home Assistant Green the built-in eMMC is usually mmcblk0 and a microSD card mmcblk1.

data_description.disks: Disks to report throughput, busy % and latency for.
data_description.interfaces: Interfaces to report traffic for. Leave empty for none.
data_description.scan_interval: Rates are averaged over the whole interval, so a longer interval only lowers resolution and means fewer recorder writes.
data_description.repairs: Show values that are bad now, or heading somewhere bad, under Settings → Repairs. The Health sensor works either way.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Host Vitals is already set up. Use Configure to change disks.

recorder_report.name: Recorder report
recorder_report.description: Find the entities, integrations and event types writing the most rows to the recorder database. Read-only; runs one database query.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: How many entities, integrations and event types to list.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Also post the report as a notification.

storage_report.name: Storage report
storage_report.description: Break down the data disk (System, add-on data, media, backups and so on) and list add-ons by data size, memory and disk writes, plus backups. Read-only; asks the Supervisor.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: How many add-ons to list (0 for all).

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Also post the report as a notification.
